name: unresponsive
description: All-zero human input for the full run (throttle/brake/steering held at 0.0, gear held in Drive). Serves md-aeb-intervention-unresponsive-driver (REQ-AD-025 step a) and, on the same asset, md-fcw-leads-intervention (step e) -- the driver never reacts, so AEB's own FCW-then-intervention sequence is the only thing that ever moves the pedals.
